PowerLink 10 – 10,000 mAh Fast Charging Power Bank with PD & Qualcomm 3.0

PowerLink 10 power bank is the ultimate fast charging for your daily life, travel, and work. Designed with cutting-edge charging technology, it features a powerful 10,000 mAh battery capacity that ensures your devices never run out of charge. The sleek clear display area lets you monitor battery levels in real time, making it both stylish and functional.

PowerLink 10 Specifications

  • Battery Capacity: 10,000 mAh
  • Output Ports: 2 USB-A, 1 USB-C, 1 Micro USB
  • Fast Charging: 22.5W Output Power
  • Charging Technology: Supports Qualcomm 3.0 + PD (Power Delivery)
  • Display: Transparent digital display area for battery percentage
  • Compatibility: Smartphones, tablets, Bluetooth devices, cameras & more

Why Choose PowerLink 10 Power Bank?

With a compact and modern design, PowerLink 10 delivers unmatched performance. The dual USB-A and Type-C ports allow you to charge multiple devices simultaneously, ensuring maximum efficiency. Whether you’re commuting, traveling, or working outdoors, this 22.5W fast charging power bank ensures your devices stay powered all day long.

Key Features & Benefits:

  • High-Speed Charging: Experience lightning-fast power delivery with Qualcomm 3.0 and PD technology.
  • Smart Display: View charge status easily with its clear LED display.
  • Universal Compatibility: Perfect for Android, iPhone, tablets, and other USB devices.
  • Portable Design: Lightweight and travel-friendly design for daily use.
  • Safe Charging: Built-in protection against overcharging, overheating, and short circuits.

Best Power Bank for Travel and Everyday Use

If you’re looking for a durable and reliable 10,000 mAh power bank, PowerLink 10 is your go-to companion. Its smart charging features make it an ideal choice for frequent travelers, professionals, and students. Charge your phone from 0 to 80% in under 40 minutes with advanced 22.5W PD fast charging support.
